notes.md: - **NITI Aayog report (1 Dec 2015):** its "Report on Developmental Support to the Successor State of Andhra Pradesh under APRA, 2014" recommended **Rs 2,100 crore** for the **7 backward districts** @ **Rs 300 crore per district**.

new.s: Which of the following districts of present Andhra Pradesh was NOT covered by the Backward Regions Grant Fund (BRGF)?
new.x: In residuary AP, BRGF covered Anantapur, Chittoor, Kadapa and Vizianagaram; Srikakulam was not among them.
new.angle: U0583 notes gap: BRGF districts in residuary AP

new.s: What share of the horticulture area of Andhra Pradesh lies in Rayalaseema?
new.x: Rayalaseema has 43% of AP's horticulture area; 52% is its share of output and 71% of micro-irrigation.
new.angle: U0583 notes gap: Rayalaseema 43% of horticulture area

new.s: Six districts of Andhra Pradesh are in India's top 10 for micro-irrigation: five Rayalaseema districts and which other district?
new.x: The six AP districts in India's top 10 for micro-irrigation are five Rayalaseema districts and Prakasam.
new.angle: U0583 notes gap: Prakasam in top 10 micro-irrigation districts

new.s: Where is the headquarters of East Coast Railway?
new.x: East Coast Railway (ECoR) has its headquarters at Bhubaneswar; South Coast Railway's is at Visakhapatnam.
new.angle: U0584 notes gap: ECoR HQ Bhubaneswar

new.s: Which Amrit Bharat station near Sriharikota was opened on 22 May 2025?
new.x: Sullurupeta, the station near Sriharikota, was opened under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme on 22 May 2025.
new.angle: U0584 notes gap: Sullurupeta Amrit Bharat station

new.s: What is the approximate cost of the Errupalem-Amaravati-Nambur new railway line approved in October 2024?
new.x: The 57 km Errupalem-Amaravati-Nambur line was approved in October 2024 at about Rs 2,245 crore.
new.angle: U0584 notes gap: Amaravati rail line cost

new.s: Which institute was the mentor of IIM Visakhapatnam when it started in September 2015?
new.x: IIM Visakhapatnam began in September 2015 with IIM Bangalore as its mentor.
new.angle: U0585 notes gap: IIM Visakhapatnam mentor IIM Bangalore

new.s: Which of the following was NOT among the six IITs added by the Institutes of Technology (Amendment) Act, 2016?
new.x: The 2016 amendment added Tirupati, Palakkad, Goa, Dharwad, Bhilai and Jammu; IIT Hyderabad was not one of them.
new.angle: U0585 notes gap: six IITs of the 2016 amendment

new.s: Ramayapatnam port, earlier in SPS Nellore district, lies in which mandal?
new.x: Ramayapatnam port was in Ulavapadu mandal of SPS Nellore district; it is now in Prakasam district.
new.angle: U0585 notes gap: Ramayapatnam port in Ulavapadu mandal

new.s: What is the estimated cost of the BPCL refinery-cum-petrochemical complex near Ramayapatnam port?
new.x: The BPCL complex near Ramayapatnam is estimated at about Rs 1.45 lakh crore (earlier about Rs 1 lakh crore).
new.angle: U0585 notes gap: BPCL refinery cost

new.s: How many industrial corridors are being developed under the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme (NICDP)?
new.x: NICDP covers 11 industrial corridors; in August 2024 the Centre approved 12 more projects under it.

new.s: Which expressway linking Maharashtra with Andhra Pradesh was fast-tracked in January 2026?
new.x: In January 2026 the Nagpur-Vijayawada and Kharagpur-Visakhapatnam-Amaravati expressways were fast-tracked.

new.s: What was the States' share in central tax devolution before the 14th Finance Commission raised it to 42%?
new.x: The States' share was 32% before the 14th Finance Commission raised it to 42%, the largest increase ever.
new.angle: U0587 notes gap: pre-14th FC share 32%

new.s: Who was the Chairman of the 15th Finance Commission?
new.x: N.K. Singh chaired the 15th Finance Commission (2021-26), which gave States 41%.
new.angle: U0587 notes gap: 15th FC chairman N.K. Singh

new.s: What is the Centre's share in the Rayalaseema Global Horticulture Hub approved in August 2026?
new.x: The Centre gave its nod with Rs 10,000 crore; the State is to put in Rs 30,000 crore.
new.angle: U0588 notes gap: Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub Centre share

new.s: How much did NITI Aayog's report of 1 December 2015 recommend for the seven backward districts of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: NITI Aayog's December 2015 report on developmental support to AP recommended Rs 2,100 crore, at Rs 300 crore per district.
new.angle: U0588 web: #7 NITI Aayog role -> backward districts recommendation

new.s: Which body recommended Rs 300 crore per district for the seven backward districts of Andhra Pradesh in a report of December 2015?
new.x: NITI Aayog's 'Report on Developmental Support to the Successor State of AP under APRA, 2014' (1 Dec 2015) recommended Rs 300 crore per district.
